actions.name: Speed Surge
actions.description: Each time this ability is activated, the mech increases the number of times it can use an action to move by 1, exceeding the normal limit of two movements per turn. This auxiliary system can be used more than once per turn.

description.value:
This system stabilizes maneuvers and enables bursts of speed.

@PPAbility[cost:2]{Speed Surge} Gain an additional movement action. This ability can be used multiple times per turn.
